task: turn on the stove and put the moka pot on it

windows.text: Hold the open gripper stationary above the table, positioned over the moka pot and stove.
Reach the open gripper horizontally toward the black stove knob.
Approach the black stove knob from above with the open gripper.
Approach the black stove knob from above, lowering the open gripper toward it.
Approach the black stove knob from above, lowering the open gripper to grasp it.
Grasp the black stove knob by closing the gripper fingers around it.
Hold the gripper stationary above the stove burner knob.
Hold the gripper on the stove knob to turn it.
Hold the gripper on the stove knob to turn it on.
Hold the gripper on the stove knob to turn it on.
Open the gripper and readjust above the stove knob.
Retract the open gripper upward and away from the stove burner.
Retract the open gripper upward and away from the stove burner.
Reach the open gripper horizontally toward the black handle of the moka pot.
Reach the open gripper horizontally toward the black handle of the moka pot.
Approach the handle of the moka pot from above, lowering the open gripper to grasp it.
Approach the handle of the moka pot from above, lowering the open gripper to position its fingers around the handle.
Grasp the handle of the moka pot with the gripper fingers closing around it.
Grasp the moka pot by its handle and lift it upward off the table.
Lift the moka pot up off the table and move it toward the stove burner.
Carry the moka pot horizontally over the stove burner.
Lower the moka pot down onto the red stove burner.
Release the moka pot onto the stove burner and open the gripper fingers.
